---
title: Inline editorial marks with attributes
format: docx
---

## Attribute forms

Editorial marks with attributes: [!! highlighted text]{#my-id .myclass}, [++ inserted text]{.insert-class}, [-- deleted text]{key="value"}, and [>> comment text]{#comment-id .comment-class key="value"}.

## Comments with author/date metadata

This is the kind of attribute pair the OOXML writer will need to turn into a
real Word comment author + timestamp:

Please tighten this paragraph [>> too wordy, can we cut the second sentence? ]{author="Alice" date="2024-01-01"}.

[++ Added per legal review.]{author="Bob" date="2024-02-14"}

[-- Remove this clause entirely.]{author="Alice" date="2024-02-15"}
